# Executive summary


---
<!-- trackio-cell
{"type": "markdown", "id": "cell_4b3d4fc6bbba", "created_at": "2026-08-01T06:47:47+00:00", "title": "Executive summary", "pinned": true, "pinned_at": "2026-08-01T06:47:48+00:00"}

All five live claims are supported **only as scoped clean-room source/theorem audits**, not as full diffusion-model training reproductions. The audits pin the arXiv source/PDF, independently check displayed exponents, assumptions, and finite arithmetic, and include condition-relaxing negative controls. No author executable was found and full diffusion training is GPU-scale; it was not attempted under the CPU-only campaign policy. Source and implementation are public at https://github.com/MachineLearning-Nerd/icml26-repro-L5JTAPUdbQ-diffusion-low-dimensional-distributions and the primary paper is https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30153.

## Scope & cost
| | This reproduction | Full replication |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Scope | Pinned-source theorem/rate audits and finite CPU controls | Train/evaluate diffusion models on the paper's distribution family |
| Hardware | Local CPU | GPU training infrastructure |
| Compute time | Seconds per audit; 5 audited claims | Unreported training-scale workload |
| Cost | $0 billed | GPU required; not attempted |
| Outcome | Five scoped source/theorem claims supported | Not reproduced |

No Hugging Face Jobs, Hub models, datasets, or Buckets were used. The source archive and PDF are retained with SHA-256 manifests in `evidence/source/`.
